text: Internet Service (broadband + narrowband) 1.46 This report is compiled on the revised definition of Broadband speed i.e. > 2Mbps, as notified by DoT on 25.01.2023. As per reports received from 1238 operators, total number of internet subscribers increased from 969.10* million at the end of Mar-25 to 1002.85 million at the end of Jun-25 with quarterly rate of growth 3.48%. Out of total 1002.85 million internet subscribers, 979.71 million were broadband subscribers and 23.14 million were narrowband subscribers. 1.47 Wired Internet subscribers increased from 41.41 million at the end of Mar-25 to 44.71 million at the end of Jun-25 with quarterly growth rate of 7.98%. Wireless Internet subscribers increased from 927.70 million at the end of Mar- 25 to 958.14 million at the end of Jun-25 with quarterly rate of growth 3.28%. 1.48 The number of Broadband subscribers increased from 944.12 million at the end of Mar-25 to 979.71 million at the end of Jun-25 with quarterly rate of growth 3.77%.
